comment: Ed is the goat. Tough class but fun if you find the joy of logic puzzles. Lots of homework but that is only to make sure you pass the exams.

Dr. Ferrier is awesome. Lots of reading but very doable as the quizzes are open notes and the content is usually pretty interesting. He also gave us the option to do corrections on our first essay which was great. Very funny and charismatic guy, I wouldn't want to take bioethics with anyone else.

Professor Ferrier at first seemed to be an overall charismatic and good professor, however, as time went on and the class got more challenging, this sadly changed. His office hours were useless as he expected you to know everything about the course as quickly as he taught it. This class was way too difficult to be a gen-ed course. Super unhelpful.
